gldf.app.title: GLDF Editor
gldf.welcome.subtitle: Global Lighting Data Format
gldf.welcome.drop_hint: Drop a GLDF, LDT, or IES file here
gldf.welcome.privacy_note: All processing happens locally in your browser - no data is uploaded.
gldf.common.name: name:
gldf.marketing.title: Marketing
gldf.marketing.description: Housing colors (RAL + name), target markets, and design awards. All scope-aware — variants may override the product-wide defaults. Approval marks have moved to their own sidebar entry (✅ Approval Marks) so the Labels/ApprovalMarks XSD overlap is explained in one place.
gldf.marketing.other_fields_note: Other Marketing fields (designer, list prices, hyperlinks) are edited on their own pages — Hyperlinks has its own sidebar entry, and List Prices/Designer are part of the Marketing schema but not yet exposed.
gldf.marketing.housing_colors.title: 🎨 Housing colors
gldf.marketing.housing_colors.descriptio: Each entry is a RAL number plus an optional localized name (e.g. "white" in en, "weiß" in de). RAL is a 4-digit integer — 9016 for traffic white, 9005 for jet black. Type a RAL name in either language and the number snaps to match.
gldf.marketing.housing_colors.name_place: (auto from RAL — or type a RAL name)
gldf.marketing.housing_colors.name_title: Type a RAL Classic colour name (DE or EN) to autofill the RAL number.
gldf.marketing.housing_colors.sync_mtl_t: Force a fresh L3D MTL sync from this RAL. Auto-fires on RAL change; this button covers the case where you dropped a new L3D file AFTER setting the RAL.
gldf.marketing.markets.title: 🌍 Markets
gldf.marketing.markets.description: Target market regions per locale (e.g. "EU" in en, "Europe" in de).
gldf.marketing.design_awards.title: 🏆 Design awards
gldf.marketing.design_awards.description: Awards the luminaire has received (e.g. Red Dot 2024, iF Design Award).
gldf.controlgear.title: Control Gear
gldf.controlgear.description: Drivers and ballasts. Each entry carries the electrical profile (voltage, standby power) and capability flags (dimmable, color-controllable). Equipment binds a ControlGear to a LightSource; per-emitter ControlGearReference picks the driver that powers that emitter slot.
gldf.controlgear.empty: No control gears declared. Add one to bind to an Equipment or per-emitter ControlGearReference.
gldf.controlgear.edit.name: Name (default locale)
gldf.controlgear.edit.other_note: Other fields (interfaces, energy labels, power consumption controls, description) preserved on save.
gldf.equipment.title: Equipment
gldf.equipment.description: Pre-assembled LightSource × ControlGear bundles, with rated input power and optional emergency-ballast parameters. Equipment is a top-level definition; downstream integrators can reference an entire assembly instead of wiring LightSource + ControlGear separately.
